column2: The 19 distinct enzyme PAIRS of the iMARS fusion set.
iMARS reports 36 fusion constructs, but a construct is a linker variant:
fifteen of the 36 are 4CL-STS with different linkers. ChannelBridge does
not fuse anything -- it searches for a relative POSE that a bispecific
binder could hold -- so the linker is not a variable here and the unit of
an example is the pair. Collapsing the 36 on (upstream, downstream) gives
these 19, numbered by first appearance in the paper's construct table.
upstream/downstream matters and is not cosmetic: O_IC is measured at the
UPSTREAM exit only, so swapping the two changes the score.
